content.text: {"label":"outage","confidence":"high","explanation":"Payments calls started climbing at 12:45 (187 vs 88.5 forecast) and reached 210 vs 85.8 at 14:15. This lines up with P1 incident INC-20261001-6607 (card authorisation gateway, debit cards declining), opened at 13:00 and still open. From 13:30 to 14:15, card_declined calls were 356 vs 48.4 expected (7.35x normal) and account for about 300 of the roughly 400 extra calls, while other reasons stayed close to normal. General's service level dip (35-65% in recent intervals) has a weaker link to the outage: general volume is only 1.5% over forecast for the day, handle time is under forecast, staffing is on plan and there are no absences, so it looks like small-queue noise or calls overflowing from payments rather than a separate cause.","evidence":[{"source":"incident","ref_id":"INC-20261001-6607","summary":"P1, opened 13:00, still open: card authorisation gateway failing, debit card transactions declining online and at POS (response code 91)."},{"source":"reason_codes","ref_id":"card_declined","summary":"Payments 13:30-14:15: 356 calls vs 48.4 expected (7.35x), 47.8% of calls vs 14% normally; about 308 extra calls."},{"source":"reason_codes","ref_id":"payment_status_enquiry","summary":"Payments: 162 vs 90 expected (1.8x), probably follow-on calls from the declines."},{"source":"metrics","ref_id":"volume","summary":"Payments volume 67-145% over forecast in every interval since 12:45; 210 vs 85.8 at 14:15.
